state.request:
Need the torque value for the M8 flange bolts on the K-series conveyor drive end (quarterly on line 3 is Fri). Also - does it change if we fit the stainless A4 replacements from stores instead of the zinc ones, and what page of the maintenance manual is that on so I can reference it in the work order.
Cheers
Ollie, Maint Team B
state.output:
Ollie,

M8 flange bolts on the K-series drive end: 25 Nm, dry, torqued in a star pattern and re-checked after the first hour of running.

For the A4 stainless replacements from stores the figure does change. Drop to 20 Nm, because stainless galls and over-torquing shears the head, and put a dab of nickel anti-seize on the threads (the 20 Nm already assumes lubricated threads). Make sure stores issue A4-80 grade, not A4-70; the -70 isn't rated for the drive end.

Both figures are in the K-series maintenance manual, rev C, in the fastener torque table under the drive assembly section. Shout if you want the stainless note added to the standard work order template.

Reza
